name: CaseTableZebraNthChild
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "table-zebra-nth-child" (table). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: zebra striping by STRUCTURAL SELECTOR - `.cf-a:nth-child(even) { background-color }` over 6 otherwise identical rows
